review.title: Forside (landing page): two hero compositions
review.intro: Same content, palette, type and markers in both variants; only the hero composition differs. Each variant is shown at 1200 px and at 375 px. The dashed magenta line marks the first screen (1200 × 760 and 375 × 667). All industry figures are invented.
review.v1.title: V1 · Centered search
review.v1.why: The organisation-number field is the page. Headline, one sentence and the field sit centred with nothing beside them; proof comes after, in three steps and then the industry overviews. Quietest first screen, and the one that says most plainly what to do.
review.v1.tradeoff: Trade-off: the first screen shows no data at all, so the claim that Peerless works from real accounts is only made in words until the visitor scrolls.
review.v2.title: V2 · Split hero
review.v2.why: Headline, sentence and field on the left; one industry-overview widget on the right as evidence of what the data can show. The steps and the remaining five widgets follow below. On a phone the widget drops below the field, so the field still comes first.
review.v2.tradeoff: Trade-off: the field shares the first screen with a chart, so it is less dominant; the widget must stay calm or it competes with the one action that matters.
review.states.title: Field states
review.states.intro: Shown at phone width. Validation runs on submit and on blur, never while typing. Spaces are accepted and ignored.
review.states.focus: Focus: 2 px navy-700 ring outside the input border
review.states.error: Malformed number: border and glyph in unfavourable #B45309, message in text colour, announced by aria-live
review.states.loading: Loading: field read-only, button disabled, status announced; no spinner over the digits
